senses.zh_definition: 英语专名 Sherlock，通常指柯南·道尔笔下的侦探夏洛克·福尔摩斯，或包含该名字的作品人物。
senses.en_definition: The proper name Sherlock, especially referring to Arthur Conan Doyle's fictional detective Sherlock Holmes.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bahasa Inggeris, khususnya nama Sherlock Holmes, watak detektif fiksyen ciptaan Arthur Conan Doyle.

etymology.historical_story: Sherlock became internationally familiar through Sherlock Holmes, introduced in Arthur Conan Doyle's A Study in Scarlet in 1887. Later stories in The Strand Magazine helped make the detective famous. For Malay learners, this is a literary name carried into discussion of books and adaptations, rather than a word assembled from Malay roots or affixes. [Conan Doyle Estate](https://conandoyleestate.com/news/on-this-day-in-history-arthur-conan-doyles-a-study-in-scarlet-was-first-published)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 Sherlock，就想起福尔摩斯拿着放大镜寻找线索；这是人物联想，不是词源拆解。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 讨论作品时直接使用 Sherlock Holmes 即可。把同事叫作 Sherlock 可能被理解为赞赏，也可能带有嘲讽，取决于语气。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合文学、影视和熟人玩笑语境。面对不熟悉典故的人，可先说明 detektif fiksyen Sherlock Holmes；正式评价他人时宜直接描述其观察或分析能力。
